AUTHOR: Zhang
TITLE: MSGNet: multi-source guidance network for fish segmentation in underwater videos
REGION: Tropical north-east Australia (DeepFish) and two estuaries in south-east Queensland, Australia (Seagrass)
SPECIES: fish vs background (binary); MoCA-Mask camouflaged animals in supplementary test
DATA: DeepFish segmentation subset (13 clips, 310 frames) + Luderick Seagrass dataset (18 clips, 4280 frames); MoCA-Mask (32 clips, 1539 frames) for separate test
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'The videos in the first two datasets suffer from severe water turbidity and insufficient lighting.'
D_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'We selected 31 video clips with 4409 images from the DeepFish dataset and Seagrass dataset at a ratio of 6:2:2 for training, validation, and testing.'
R_EV: Sec. 2.1: MoCA-Mask frames 'were divided into a training set, validation set, and test set at a ratio of 6:2:2' (trained/tested within each dataset)
E_EV: Table 4: only 'mPA/%' and 'mIoU/%' reported; size estimation only mentioned as potential application
ARCH: MSGNet: dual-stream shared ResNet-101 encoder with M-CAGM co-attention and FAFM fusion; RAFT optical flow; FCN preprocessing

PLAT: DeepFish 'high-definition digital camera', Seagrass 'submerged action cameras' (stationary RUV) -> coded fixed camera, platform not explicitly stated.
